data.title: Haya on the Park
data.about:
Haya on the Park at Town Square Dubai by Nshama offers a curated selection of modern residential apartments ideally located in a prestigious and vibrant neighborhood. Investors and homebuyers can choose among the 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom duplexes. Sleek lines, large windows, and dynamic features are some of the highlights of the interiors. Moreover, all units comprise fully-equipped kitchens with modern appliances, porcelain flooring, and built-in wardrobes.
Haya on the Park Town Square location has everything you need, from jogging tracks and cycling lanes to cozy cafes and convenient retail outlets. The lush green spaces around the area further enhance the beauty and elegance of this place.

characteristics_module.title: Thoughtfully Designed Apartments With Optimal Space, Light, and Comfort!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• You can choose from a range of Haya on the Park floor plans, ranging from a 1-bedroom apartment to a 3-bedroom duplex unit.
  • The interiors are adorned with rich, earthy tones and carefully selected materials, creating a warm and sophisticated ambiance.
  • Start your journey with just a 10% down payment, making it easier to secure your dream home while enjoying a manageable payment structure.
  • Enjoy an active lifestyle at Town Square with a dedicated 3 km cycling trail, perfect for daily exercise and leisurely rides.
  • The area boasts an expansive 260,000 square meters of green areas, providing residents with ample outdoor space to relax and enjoy nature.
  • Town Square Dubai is an ideal family-friendly community, offering a harmonious blend of modern amenities and a tranquil environment.

location_tile.title: Revel in the Serenity of Nature Just Outside Your Door
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Town Square Dubai is an ideal family-friendly community, offering a harmonious blend of modern amenities and a tranquil environment. Designed with families in mind, the neighborhood features spacious green areas, parks, and playgrounds that provide a safe and welcoming space for children to play and explore. 
Residents can access the centrally located Town Square Park, a sprawling 50,000 square meters beautifully landscaped space ideal for gatherings, picnics, and outdoor activities. The community also offers a variety of recreational facilities, such as cycling trails, fitness centers, and swimming pools.

Dubai Miracle Garden - 15 Minutes
Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club - 10 Minutes
Dubai Hills Mall - 20 Minutes
District 2020 - 20 Minutes
Burj Al Arab - 24 Minutes
Al Maktoum International Airport - 25 Minutes
Dubai International Airport - 28 Minutes

seo.metaTitle: Haya on the Park Nshama Apartments
seo.metaDescription: Discover Haya on the Park at Town Square Dubai by Nshama. The project consists of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom duplexes.

more_info.answer: Investing in Haya on the Park is straightforward and flexible, designed to accommodate your financial plans. Begin your investment with a 10% down payment. The remaining payments are structured to align with the project’s development phases, with 60% due during the construction period and the final 40% payable upon handover.
more_info.question: How do you invest in Haya on the Park, Dubai?

more_info.answer:
The properties at Haya on the Park offer a variety of spacious living options:
1 Bedroom Apartments: Ranging from 680 to 736 square feet.
2 Bedroom Apartments: Ranging from 980 to 1,216 square feet.
3 Bedroom Apartments: Ranging from 1,391 to 1,700 square feet.
more_info.question: What is the covered area of Haya on the Park Nshama properties?

more_info.answer: The project is slated for completion in February 2027.
